<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex50122024-09-1712-56-13" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon">
         <milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (ku_14a7-14b1) pp. 279-280"/>
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">bla ma rnams</rs> kyi bka' drin las <lb n="14a8"/> cung zad thos pa dang thob pa rnams | dran par bya zhing bskul ba'i bsam pa rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir yi ger bris pa'o || <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4052">shAkya'i btsun pa smon lam <pb n="14b"/><lb n="14b1"/> tshul khrims</rs> kyis thos yig go | ||

         <milestone unit="section" n="Post-colophon annotation : Owner (ku_14b2) p. 280"/>
         <lb n="14b2"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4864">shAkya'i btsun pa rtsed pa bsod nams blo gros</rs> kyi dpe'o ||</seg></TEI>
